h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Haridwar

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Haridwar

items.pText: Haridwar lies where the Ganga leaves the Himalayan foothills for the plains, and its ashrams, hotels, schools and industrial colonies share a setting of river, forest and hills. Many buyers here want a play area that sits quietly in those surroundings. FunPlay Systems designs and makes playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,290 km away, and sends it to Uttarakhand by road.

For a softer look, we often suggest our Organic Play structures, shaped like animals and plants, or the wooden pieces in our NexLev series. Haridwar has hot summers, a heavy monsoon and cold winters, and wood needs more care than steel and plastic in all three. We explain that difference at the start, so you can choose with your maintenance staff in mind. A layout drawing with the safe play area marked follows once we see photos of your site.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Play equipment that suits an ashram or hotel garden

c: Organic Play is designed by our own team, with structures shaped like a snail, a parrot, a toucan or a monstera leaf. They bring nature into the garden without looking out of place. Wooden NexLev structures look the most natural of all but need regular cleaning, checks of the fixings and protection from standing water. Under large trees, leaves collect on decks, so plan a sweeping routine. Greens and earthy tones from our colour shades blend in well.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,290 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can playground equipment be made in natural colours?
items.a: Yes. We offer more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades, including greens and earthy tones, and our design team can customise a structure to suit a garden or ashram setting.

items.q: Is wooden play equipment practical in Haridwar?
items.a: It works with regular care. The monsoon and the cold winters are hard on wood, so plan cleaning and checks of the fixings. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic need far less looking after.

items.q: Do you supply ashrams and hotels in Haridwar?
items.a: Yes. Ashrams, hotels, schools and colonies can all order from us. We send equipment from Vasai to Haridwar by road, and our installation team or a local dealer installs it on site.
